summary: Gates were the driver's green sweep. I read all four repos' diffs (the two generators are AST-identical across the new surface) and mutation-tested both generators and the handover check. On a snapshot whose helm-charts envelope is the local HelmCharts render (e134d28), all 16 held apps were scaffolded and pass `argo_migrate.py arch`, redrawing all 23 helm-charts-drawn edges with the same ids. The same gate stops them on the live set, as expected before the HelmCharts push. V01, V03-V12, V14 and V15 pass. V02 and V13 are owed to the bulk-migration session's HelmCharts push (Ruling Q1, close-out A1): run `~/bulk-migration/hc-push.sh`, then wait for `AaC/HelmCharts` and the `AaC/Architecture` collect to go green, then `python3 support/argo-migrate/argo_migrate.py arch <the 16 apps>` with no `--dataset`. Ansible f2db525, ArgoCDTools ce5efb9 and AnsibleSpecs are pushed; `IaC/Build-Main` #199 (lint, validate, plan, destroy check) and `IaC/ArgoCDTools` #11 are green. Nothing in this slice converges hosts, so there is no `iac-apply` to start. Findings that did not clear the bar are in close-out: N1, S5 and a note on S3. The record is in test_r1/.
